candidate_2_cross_model_disagreement.reason_not_promoted: magnitude-only signal cannot by itself produce a bias correction; not directly testable as a standalone MAE-reduction mechanism against G1-G4

candidate_3_a_nwp_volatility.target: H9-H12 error via its strongest post-hoc correlate: within-day irradiance volatility (r=0.73, Phase 3, diagnostic only)
candidate_3_a_nwp_volatility.previously_blocked_reason: raw Stage 8.1 feature matrix not present in original five handoff files

audit_findings.forecast_structure: single 00Z-issued 24h forecast per origin, non-overlapping, timestamp = forecast_start + (horizon_hour - 1) hours, verified exactly for all rows
audit_findings.causal_availability_conclusion: Entire day's forecast trajectory is produced by one t0 run; any same-day aggregate statistic is causally available at t0 for every horizon in that day. No actual/observed future SW_IN or post-t0 information used.

candidate_signal.name: nwp_cloud_daytime_std
candidate_signal.definition: standard deviation of forecast cloud_frac trajectory over the daytime hours of the origin's day
candidate_signal.interpretation: real but weak/smoothed proxy for the true difficult regime

control_reproduction_g6.reason_gap: original Stage 8.1 training hyperparameters/code unavailable in this session
control_reproduction_g6.validity_of_relative_comparison: Candidate A and control were trained identically (same features pipeline, same model class, same folds), so the relative EVEN-only OOF delta is a valid apples-to-apples diagnostic despite the absolute reproduction gap.

experiment.design: 5-fold GroupKFold by origin_id, EVEN-only, control = 37 official features, candidate = 37 features + nwp_cloud_daytime_std, identical HistGradientBoostingRegressor

G4.requirement: candidate nMAE <= control AND candidate RMSE <= control

candidate_3_a_nwp_volatility.not_promoted_reason: small favorable mean effect but insufficient magnitude (fails G1) and insufficient fold consistency (fails G2)
candidate_3_a_nwp_volatility.scope_note: Not evidence that NWP volatility is useless in general; evidence that this specific preregistered minimal implementation does not clear the POLARIS promotion bar.

final_scientific_conclusion.statement: No robust improvement over the protected Stage 8.1 champion was demonstrated within the tested, causally valid candidate space.
explicit_non_claims: Does NOT claim 28.0688% nMAE is a theoretical or fundamental lower bound.
Does NOT claim no future method could improve it.
Does NOT claim all regime-aware methods are impossible.

limitations_for_future_sessions: G6 was not strictly achieved: original Stage 8.1 training hyperparameters/code unavailable in this session; reconstructed control approximates but does not exactly match the official champion (~2% gap). Future sessions must treat the official numbers as ground truth and the reconstructed control as a same-session diagnostic baseline only.

Candidate A's forecast-volatility signal correlated only r~0.28 with actual volatility vs r~0.73 for the post-hoc actual signal, suggesting a higher-resolution NWP volatility representation (if one exists upstream, e.g. ensemble spread) might carry more signal. This is an open question, not a recommendation to act on, and was not tested.
